title: Generic server startup reseeds and overwrites restored checkpoint client-selection RNG.
origin: FD-D-R01 exposed startup ordering in FedDyn design review; root independently reproduced with actual generic checkpoint writer/reader, not a proposed FedDyn checkpoint method.
expected: After selections [9,7], [5,6] at seed17 for N10 andper_round2, resume round2 and select [5,3].
method: Actual FedAvg Server instance with real ComposableTrainer, save_to_checkpoint, _resume_from_checkpoint, Server.run and random-selection strategy. configure fixture preserves constructed trainer; disable clients, no-op periodic and start capture avoid datasource/network/process setup only. Model weights, round and NumPy restore correctly while Python client-selection resets.
boundary: Does not claim full network/training continuation; actual persistence/startup/selection path verifies material ordering defect.
regression_requirement: Actual saved checkpoint -> run/resume -> next selections with nontrivial saved seed state on both interpreters; preserve fresh-run seeding, no-configured-seed behavior, ordinary/central startup branches and the existing48startup tests. Keep checkpoints/names/format and accepted runtime transport behavior.
root_ownership_handoff: Root reclaims plato/servers/base.py startup/RNG lifecycle only from completed C filename handoff and assigns original B author. C current correction scope does not require this file. Separate worktrees; merge reviewed supplemental B at a clean C boundary and rerun combined checkpoint/startup tests. No generic authentication/protocol redesign.
